description: Conventional Commits linter — Offline Conventional Commits 1.0 check for a commit message. Give message= (the full message, %0A for new lines) and optional types= (comma list to override the allowed types) and max_header= (default 100). Parses type, scope, ! and BREAKING CHANGE footers, body and trailers; flags a missing blank line, unknown type, capitalized or period-ended subject, past-tense verbs, vague subjects and long lines; returns the implied semver bump (major/minor/patch/none), issue refs and a corrected header. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).

message.description: e.g. feat(api): add rate limit headers

name: dev_commit_lint
